name: leanix-api
description: Skill for the SAP LeanIX APIs with a focus on getting access set up correctly and working with fact sheets: technical users and API tokens, the OAuth2 client-credentials token exchange, Admin/Member/Viewer roles, per-type permissions, custom roles and virtual workspaces (ACEs), least-privilege choices per integration, 401/403/429 troubleshooting; the GraphQL API (allFactSheets facet filters, cursor pagination, inline fragments, createFactSheet/updateFactSheet JSON patches for fields, lifecycle, tags, relations, external ids, archiving); the Integration API (LDIF, processors, JUEL, synchronization runs, deletion scope); webhooks, Metrics v2, Excel import/export, Pathfinder REST, the MTM user-management API and the SAP LeanIX MCP server. Includes references, an official docs snapshot, a curated OpenAPI 3.1 spec and a dependency-free Python client/CLI.
